en_meaning: Hasty and therefore not thorough or detailed
vi_meaning: Nhanh, lướt qua, không kỹ lưỡng
example_sentence: A cursory inspection of the archival manuscripts failed to reveal the subtle marginalia that later proved crucial to deciphering the author's true intent.

en_meaning: To reduce in extent or quantity; to impose a restriction on
vi_meaning: Cắt bớt, rút ngắn, hạn chế
example_sentence: In response to mounting inflationary pressures and widening budget deficits, the ministry was forced to curtail public expenditures on infrastructure.

en_meaning: Believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest; distrustful of sincerity
vi_meaning: Hoài nghi, cay độc, thiếu tin tưởng vào lòng tốt
example_sentence: Hardened by decades of political corruption and broken campaign promises, the electorate adopted an increasingly cynical view of government reform initiatives.

en_meaning: A person or thing that is the center of attention or admiration
vi_meaning: Trung tâm của sự chú ý, tâm điểm ngưỡng mộ
example_sentence: With its soaring cantilevered arches and iridescent glass facade, the newly inaugurated concert hall quickly became the architectural cynosure of the entire metropolis.

en_meaning: To take part in an activity in a casual or superficial way
vi_meaning: Học đòi, tham gia một cách tài tử, không chuyên sâu
example_sentence: Although the Renaissance polymath chose to dabble in alchemy and astrology during his youth, his lasting intellectual legacy rested upon rigorous empirical mathematics.

en_meaning: A low platform for a lectern, seats of honor, or a throne
vi_meaning: Bục danh dự, bục phát biểu
example_sentence: Ascending the velvet-draped dais at the front of the council chamber, the chancellor prepared to deliver his annual address to the assembled foreign dignitaries.

en_meaning: unpleasantly damp, cold, and often musty
vi_meaning: Ẩm thấp, lạnh lẽo và khó chịu
example_sentence: Deep within the medieval fortress's subterranean vaults, centuries of archival parchment were slowly degraded by the dank, unventilated air.

en_meaning: neat and trim in appearance and dress
vi_meaning: Gọn gàng, bảnh bao, tươm tất
example_sentence: Attired in a bespoke three-piece tweed suit and polished leather brogues, the dapper literary critic commanded immediate respect upon entering the lecture hall.

en_meaning: marked with spots or rounded patches of color
vi_meaning: Lốm đốm, loang lổ bóng râm và ánh sáng
example_sentence: Midday sunlight filtering through the dense canopy of ancient oaks cast a dappled pattern of gold and deep shadow across the forest path.

en_meaning: to spread a substance thickly or carelessly on a surface
vi_meaning: Phết, trét, bôi cẩu thả
example_sentence: Rejecting classical smoothing techniques, the neo-expressionist painter used a wooden spatula to daub thick impasto swathes of crimson across the canvas.

en_meaning: to make someone feel intimidated or apprehensive
vi_meaning: Làm nản lòng, làm thoái chí
example_sentence: Neither the vast expanse of the frozen polar tundra nor the perilous threat of blizzards could daunt the resolute polar explorers.

en_meaning: Showing fearlessness and determination; bold and brave
vi_meaning: Dũng cảm, kiên cường, bất khuất
example_sentence: Celebrated in maritime lore, the dauntless captain steered his battered frigate straight through the hurricane to rescue the stranded whaling fleet.

en_meaning: To waste time or move slowly and aimlessly
vi_meaning: Nhởn nhơ, lãng phí thời gian, chậm chạp
example_sentence: With the tide rising swiftly toward the cliff base, the marine surveyors could not dawdle while gathering intertidal specimen samples.

en_meaning: A situation where no progress is possible; a stalemate
vi_meaning: Sự đình trệ, tình trạng bế tắc hoàn toàn
example_sentence: Bipartisan congressional negotiations reached an intractable deadlock when both committees refused to concede on key statutory spending caps.

en_meaning: Deliberately impassive or expressionless, especially for humorous effect
vi_meaning: Thản nhiên, tỉnh bơ, không biểu cảm
example_sentence: Delivering devastating satirical commentary with a completely deadpan demeanor, the essayist maintained an unsmiling gravity that amplified the humor.

en_meaning: A scarcity or lack of something
vi_meaning: Sự khan hiếm, tình trạng thiếu thốn
example_sentence: An acute dearth of dependable documentary records from the early medieval kingdom forces contemporary historians to rely heavily on archaeological fragments.

en_meaning: A sudden and complete failure or fiasco
vi_meaning: Thất bại thảm hại, sự sụp đổ hoàn toàn
example_sentence: Plagued by critical software errors and unprecedented cost overruns, the highly publicized satellite deployment unravelled into an embarrassing public relations debacle.

en_meaning: To lower the quality, value, or character of something
vi_meaning: Làm giảm giá trị, làm suy đồi phẩm chất
example_sentence: To finance prolonged foreign conflicts, the Roman emperor ordered the imperial mint to debase silver denarii with inferior alloys of copper and tin.

en_meaning: To corrupt morally or indulge in excessive pleasure
vi_meaning: Làm đồi bại, sa đọa, làm hư hỏng
example_sentence: Exploiting the young nobleman's sudden inheritance, unprincipled courtiers conspired to debauch his senses with illicit gambling and lavish revelry.

en_meaning: To make someone or something very weak or infirm
vi_meaning: Làm suy nhược, làm kiệt quệ
example_sentence: A protracted drought threatened to debilitate the agrarian regional economy, exhausting groundwater reservoirs and stunting seasonal crop yields.

en_meaning: Confident, stylish, and charming, typically used for a man
vi_meaning: Lịch lãm, hào hoa, phong nhã
example_sentence: Possessing an easy elegance and quick cosmopolitan wit, the debonair ambassador put rival emissaries at ease during the contentious peace summit.

en_meaning: Scattered pieces of waste or remains of something destroyed
vi_meaning: Mảnh vỡ, đống đổ nát, tàn tích
example_sentence: Following the seismic shockwave, geological teams carefully examined the volcanic debris strewn across the caldera to reconstruct the eruption sequence.

en_meaning: To expose the falseness or hollowness of a myth, idea, or belief
vi_meaning: Vạch trần, bóc trần sự sai lệch
example_sentence: Through methodical spectroscopic analysis, the astrophysicist managed to debunk the sensational hypothesis that celestial signals originated from intelligent alien life.

en_meaning: A young woman making her formal entrance into society
vi_meaning: Thiếu nữ quý tộc lần đầu ra mắt giới thượng lưu
example_sentence: In Edwardian London, an aristocratic debutante was expected to observe strict rules of etiquette upon her presentation at the royal court.

en_meaning: Moral or cultural decline as characterized by excessive indulgence in pleasure or luxury
vi_meaning: Sự suy đồi, tình trạng sa đọa đạo đức hoặc văn hóa
example_sentence: Moral philosophers argued that the unchecked decadence of the gilded elite inevitably blinded them to the simmering grievances of the working class.

en_meaning: To cut off the head of a person or animal
vi_meaning: Chặt đầu, xử trảm
example_sentence: During the zenith of the French Revolution, the radical Jacobin regime voted to decapitate King Louis XVI upon the scaffold in the Place de la Révolution.

en_meaning: To reduce the speed of something; to slow down
vi_meaning: Giảm tốc độ, đi chậm lại
example_sentence: As monetary policymakers tightened credit to curb speculative bubbles, industrial investment and wage growth began to decelerate precipitously.

en_meaning: Shedding leaves annually at the end of the growing season
vi_meaning: Rụng lá hằng năm, sớm rụng
example_sentence: Unlike the evergreen conifers dominating boreal landscapes, deciduous broadleaf trees enter winter dormancy by shedding their foliage to minimize moisture loss.

en_meaning: To destroy or kill a large part of a group or population
vi_meaning: Tàn phá nặng nề, tiêu diệt số lượng lớn
example_sentence: The arrival of European pathogens such as smallpox proceeded to decimate indigenous populations who possessed no acquired immunological resistance.

en_meaning: A water-soluble cleansing agent used for washing clothes or dishes
vi_meaning: Chất tẩy rửa
example_sentence: Environmental chemists demonstrated that phosphorus-rich synthetic detergent runoff accelerates harmful algal blooms that deplete dissolved oxygen in aquatic habitats.

en_meaning: To succeed in understanding or interpreting something complicated or secret
vi_meaning: Giải mã, làm sáng tỏ điều phức tạp
example_sentence: Working in seclusion at Bletchley Park, cryptanalysts designed early electromechanical computing devices to decipher encrypted Enigma military communications.

en_meaning: A downward slope or surface
vi_meaning: Dốc thoai thoải xuống, sườn dốc xuống
example_sentence: Heavy seasonal rains saturated the steep declivity above the mountain hamlet, causing dislodged boulders and mud to cascade down the hillside.

en_meaning: Having a low neckline on a garment
vi_meaning: Khoét sâu cổ áo
example_sentence: The portrait sparked aristocratic controversy for depicting the young marchioness in a daringly decollete velvet evening bodice.

en_meaning: The process of decaying or breaking down into smaller parts
vi_meaning: Sự phân hủy, quá trình phân rã
example_sentence: Forest saprophytes play an indispensable ecological role by driving the decomposition of fallen timber into bioavailable soil nutrients.

en_meaning: Behavior in keeping with good taste and propriety
vi_meaning: Sự đúng mực, phép lịch sự, phong thái đoan trang
example_sentence: Even when enduring aggressive questioning during senate hearings, the judicial nominee preserved impeccable decorum and spoke in measured, respectful tones.

en_meaning: A person or thing used to mislead or lure into a trap
vi_meaning: Mồi nhử, vật nghi binh đánh lạc hướng
example_sentence: Allied commanders positioned dummy inflatable tanks along the coastline to serve as an elaborate decoy, deceiving axis reconnaissance regarding the true invasion site.

en_meaning: Elderly and infirm; worn out or ruined because of age or neglect
vi_meaning: Già yếu, rệu rã, mục nát
example_sentence: The rural community struggled to preserve its decrepit timber covered bridge after decades of weathering and structural rot weakened its floor joists.

en_meaning: The state of being decrepit; physical weakness due to old age
vi_meaning: Tình trạng già yếu, sự rệu rã, tình trạng đổ nát
example_sentence: Once a resplendent symbol of imperial prestige, the abandoned palace succumbed to architectural decrepitude as weeds cracked its marble terraces.

en_meaning: To publicly denounce or express strong disapproval of something
vi_meaning: Công khai chỉ trích, lên án
example_sentence: Humanitarian observers stepped forward to decry the arbitrary detention of peaceful demonstrators as an egregious violation of basic civil liberties.

en_meaning: Able to be logicaly derived or figured out from available information
vi_meaning: Có thể suy luận được từ thông tin sẵn có
example_sentence: From the periodic dimming of the star's stellar luminosity, the presence of an orbiting gas giant was readily deducible without direct telescopic imaging.

en_meaning: To spoil the surface or appearance of something, often by writing or drawing on it
vi_meaning: Làm hư hại bề mặt, bôi bẩn làm mất mỹ quan
example_sentence: Outraged citizens condemned the vandals who conspired to deface the bronze war memorial with crude markings overnight.

en_meaning: To damage the good reputation of someone by spreading false information
vi_meaning: Phỉ báng, bôi nhọ thanh danh
example_sentence: In his opening statement, the barrister argued that sensationalist tabloids printed falsehoods specifically designed to defame the prime minister's personal integrity.

en_meaning: Failure to fulfill an obligation, especially to repay a loan or appear in court
vi_meaning: Sự vỡ nợ, sự không thực hiện được nghĩa vụ
example_sentence: Fearing sovereign default on national sovereign bonds, credit rating agencies downgraded the country's debt to junk status.

en_meaning: Demonstrating expectation or acceptance of failure
vi_meaning: Bi quan, có tư tưởng chủ bại
example_sentence: The prime minister urged the wartime cabinet to banish all defeatist rhetoric and focus instead on mobilizing industrial capacity for national defense.

en_meaning: The desertion of one's country or cause in favor of an opposing one
vi_meaning: Sự đào ngũ, sự phản bội đào tẩu
example_sentence: The sudden defection of the chief nuclear scientist dealt a catastrophic blow to the regime's clandestine weapons development program.

en_meaning: To put off an action or event to a later time; postpone
vi_meaning: Trì hoãn, hoãn lại
example_sentence: Confronted by inconclusive clinical trial results, the regulatory panel voted to defer final approval of the therapeutic compound until further data emerged.

en_meaning: Humble submission and respect toward the judgment or wishes of another
vi_meaning: Sự tôn kính, sự chiều theo ý kiến người khác vì nể trọng
example_sentence: Showing great deference to constitutional precedent, the appellate judges refrained from overturning the longstanding common-law doctrine.

en_meaning: Open resistance or bold disobedience to authority or an opposing force
vi_meaning: Sự thách thức, thái độ bất tuân công khai
example_sentence: Standing resolutely before an unyielding military cordon, the factory strikers raised their banners in collective defiance of the martial decree.

en_meaning: To damage the purity or appearance of something; to desecrate
vi_meaning: Làm ô uế, báng bổ sự thanh khiết
example_sentence: Environmental advocates filed a federal suit against the chemical manufacturer for permitting toxic industrial effluent to defile the pristine river basin.

en_meaning: Done or reached decisively and with authority; providing a final solution
vi_meaning: Dứt khoát, mang tính quyết định, có thẩm quyền tối hậu
example_sentence: Scholars universally regarded the professor's monumental archival study as the definitive historical treatment of the diplomatic crisis of 1914.
